user_query: I want to obtain real-time financial data for analysis, including trading data, ceil transformation, ROCR ratio, and fair value analysis for a specific stock.

TaskList.description: Fetch the latest market trading data including prices, volumes, and trends.
Apply ceil transformation to the fetched trading data to adjust values appropriately.
Calculate the ROCR (Rate of Change Ratio) using the transformed trading data.
Conduct a fair value analysis for a specified stock to determine its intrinsic value.
